MODUL = 1000000007

class Mat:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.size = size
        self.mat = [[0] * size for _ in range(size)]
        
    def __mul__(self, other):
        c = Mat(self.size)
        for i in range(self.size):
            for j in range(self.size):
                total = 0
                for k in range(self.size):
                    total += self.mat[i][k] * other.mat[k][j]
                c.mat[i][j] = total % MODUL
        return c

def main():
    n, m = map(int, input().split())
    A = Mat(m + 1)
    I = Mat(m + 1)
    for i in range(m + 1):
        A.mat[i][i] = 1
        A.mat[0][i] = 1
        I.mat[i][i] = 1

    y_factor = 1
    y_power = 1
    level = 0
    sum_ = 0
    while y_power * m <= n:
        y_power *= m
        level += 1

    bi_m = [[Mat(m + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)] for _ in range(level + 1)]
    for t in range(level + 1):
        if t > 0:
            bi_m[t][0] = bi_m[t - 1][0]
            for i in range(1, m + 1):
                bi_m[t][0] = bi_m[t][0] * bi_m[t - 1][i]
        for i in range(1, m + 1):
            bi_m[t][i] = bi_m[t][i - 1]
            for j in range(m - 2, -1, -1):
                for k in range(m + 1):
                    bi_m[t][i].mat[j][k], bi_m[t][i].mat[j + 1][k] = bi_m[t][i].mat[j + 1][k], bi_m[t][i].mat[j][k]
            for j in range(m - 2, -1, -1):
                for k in range(m + 1):
                    bi_m[t][i].mat[k][j], bi_m[t][i].mat[k][j + 1] = bi_m[t][i].mat[k][j + 1], bi_m[t][i].mat[k][j]

    res = I
    sum_ = 0
    while sum_ < n:
        if sum_ + y_power <= n:
            sum_ += y_power
            res = res * bi_m[level][0]
            y_factor = (y_factor + 1) % m
        else:
            y_power //= m
            level -= 1

    answ = 0
    for i in range(m + 1):
        answ = (answ + res.mat[i][m]) % MODUL
    print(answ)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
